title: AI can steal your game, it can't steal the tools
author: YosemiteCalamity
selftext:
112k lines now for 'tools'.

If like myself, you've made a ton of custom tools to manage and scale your game, look up the 'editor' folder in Unity (or its equivalent in any other game engine).

Any code added to this folder will be 100% erased for the game build.

This is major, because short of paying for Denuvo, there is no way to stop AI from stealing your game's source code.

You can only frustrate it, but not prevent a dedicated thief from stealing everything.

Second safeguard is IP.

The minute you draw something by hand, or write something by hand, it is instantly protected by law. Provided it is not gen-AI, you have no requirement to file for a patent for original story content or artwork. 

It is protected by law by default.

Both of the above are your strongest weapons against thieves.

They're predatory in the sense they don't have ideas of their own, so you don't have to worry about IP originality (massively beyond all current LLMs) or custom tools (well within the reach of AI cloning, but you are 100% immune to theft here if you just organise your build correctly at launch).
